title: Grateful Dead Live at The Music Box on 1969-04-15
lineage: CD -> EAC -> Samplitude Professional v7.02 -> FLAC
source: Aiwa hand-held microphone -> Master Reel (Aiwa 5" reel-to-reel) -> Alesis Masterlink 9600 -> Hard Drive -> CD

ai_review.summary: Warm audience capture of a fiery 1969 show highlighted by an incendiary Other One and soaring Dark Star despite lo‑fi mic limitations.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised as one of the year’s finest, with Jerry Garcia delivering blistering leads on early numbers and a powerful Other One that drives the set. Even though the recording was made with a handheld microphone and suffers from limited fidelity, listeners appreciate its atmosphere and warmth, making it an enjoyable listen for fans.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show highly (4–5 stars) and highlight standout performances; recording quality is noted as sub‑par but still listenable, yielding a weighted average around 4.1.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Handheld mic capture with limited fidelity—some muddiness and lack of detail—but enough ambience and warmth to convey the venue’s intimate atmosphere.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set starts a bit tentative, then quickly heats up as the crowd blends with the band; extended improvisations on Dark Star and a scorching Other One give the show its legendary momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia is described as "on fire" with pedal‑steel‑influenced leads, double bends, and fiery solos that shape the early tunes.
